abstract: Reproduces the strong 9‑minute exact‑accept SA baseline (seed=20251021) and applies a 2e‑9 feasibility polish on radii to guarantee non‑overlap. No extra quenches/kicks.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp_exact_params as P
from active_quench import solve_radii_lp_safe, finalize_feasible, clamp01

def construct_packing():
    # 9-minute exact-accept SA baseline with prior best settings
    centers, radii, score = P.exact_sa_params(
        budget_sec=540.0,
        seed=20251021,
        step0=0.035,
        ar_lo=0.15, ar_hi=0.30,
        quench_interval=12.0, quench_tries=60,
        margins=(0.04, 0.06),
        two_phase=True,
        step_minmax_phase1=(0.005, 0.08),
        step_minmax_phase2=(0.004, 0.04),
    )
    centers = clamp01(centers)

    # Recompute exact radii (near-tight) then robustly finalize to ensure non-overlap
    r_exact, _, _ = solve_radii_lp_safe(centers, eps_pair=1e-12)
    r_final = finalize_feasible(centers, r_exact, margin=2e-9)

    # Validity checks
    assert centers.shape == (26,2)
    assert r_final.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(r_final > 0)
    x, y = centers[:,0], centers[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(r_final <= b + 1e-9)

    return centers, r_final
